status: Frozen revision-only analysis contract. No model retraining and no changes to accepted Study 1, E1, E2, or nonlinear-baseline outputs.

inference.e1_pairwise_multiplicity: Holm across all six exploratory intervention pairs

site_curve_weights.sensitivity: uniform average across the five grid points

inference.participant_weighting: Weight each held-out-site estimate by its analysis-manifest participant count; resample sites as clusters and recompute normalized weights in every bootstrap sample.
inference.model_level_intervals: Equal-site bootstrap intervals for each reported classical and neural model summary.

heat_spectrum.eigenvalue_computation: Use the symmetric-similar normalized Laplacian I - D^-1/2 A D^-1/2.

claim_limits: All revision analyses are post-hoc descriptive or sensitivity analyses.
Do not change any frozen accuracy, AUROC, interval, or intervention result.
Do not describe absence of significance as equivalence.
Do not attribute QC attrition to motion without reporting the observed framewise-displacement distributions.
Do not claim that a representation diagnostic caused predictive performance.
Do not interpret functional-connectivity signs or bundle maps as biological excitation, inhibition, causal flow, or brain geometry.
